So I need to move DOWN first, then LEFT.
Actually, looking at the image more carefully, the player (green) is to the right of the bottom blue box. The bottom blue box is at row 37-38, col 33-34, and the player is at row 32-35, col 36-39. So the player is above and to the right of the bottom blue box. I need to move LEFT to align with the blue box, then DOWN to reach it.

But wait, the player is at row 32-35 and the blue box is at row 37-38. They're not on the same row. So moving LEFT won't put the player adjacent to the blue box vertically. I need to move DOWN first to reach the blue box's row.
Let me try DOWN to move closer to the bottom blue box.
